package student

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"path"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

const (
	publicationMaxArchiveBytes = 20 << 20
	publicationMaxFileBytes    = 512 << 10
	publicationMaxTotalBytes   = 5 << 20
	publicationMaxFiles        = 500
)

var (
	publicationTextExtensions = map[string]struct{}{
		".bash": {}, ".c": {}, ".cc": {}, ".conf": {}, ".cpp": {}, ".cs": {}, ".css": {},
		".dart": {}, ".env.example": {}, ".go": {}, ".gql": {}, ".graphql": {}, ".h": {},
		".hpp": {}, ".htm": {}, ".html": {}, ".ini": {}, ".java": {}, ".js": {}, ".json": {},
		".jsx": {}, ".kt": {}, ".kts": {}, ".less": {}, ".md": {}, ".mod": {}, ".php": {},
		".properties": {}, ".proto": {}, ".py": {}, ".rb": {}, ".rs": {}, ".sass": {},
		".scss": {}, ".sh": {}, ".sql": {}, ".sum": {}, ".svelte": {}, ".swift": {}, ".toml": {},
		".ts": {}, ".tsx": {}, ".txt": {}, ".vue": {}, ".xml": {}, ".yaml": {}, ".yml": {}, ".zsh": {},
	}
	publicationAllowedExtensionless = map[string]struct{}{
		"dockerfile": {}, "makefile": {}, "procfile": {},
	}
	publicationExcludedSegments = map[string]struct{}{
		".git": {}, ".idea": {}, ".next": {}, ".ssh": {}, ".vscode": {}, "build": {},
		"coverage": {}, "dist": {}, "node_modules": {}, "target": {}, "vendor": {},
	}
	publicationSensitiveNames = map[string]struct{}{
		".env": {}, ".netrc": {}, ".npmrc": {}, "credentials": {}, "credentials.json": {},
		"id_ed25519": {}, "id_rsa": {}, "secrets.json": {},
	}
	publicationSensitiveSuffixes = []string{".key", ".p12", ".pem", ".pfx", ".sqlite", ".sqlite3"}
	publicationSecretPatterns    = []struct {
		code    string
		pattern *regexp.Regexp
		value   int
	}{
		{code: "private_key", pattern: regexp.MustCompile(`-----BEGIN (?:[A-Z0-9 ]+ )?PRIVATE KEY-----`)},
		{code: "aws_access_key", pattern: regexp.MustCompile(`\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b`)},
		{code: "github_token", pattern: regexp.MustCompile(`\bgh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}\b`)},
		{code: "jwt", pattern: regexp.MustCompile(`\beyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\b`)},
		{
			code:    "credential_assignment",
			pattern: regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|auth[_-]?token|client[_-]?secret|password|passwd|secret[_-]?key)\s*[:=]\s*["']?([^\s"',;]{8,})`),
			value:   2,
		},
		{
			code:    "credential_uri",
			pattern: regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)\b[a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://[^\s:/]+:([^\s/@]{8,})@`),
			value:   1,
		},
	}
)

type publicationSecurityFinding struct {
	Path string `json:"path"`
	Code string `json:"code"`
	Line int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
}

type PublicationSecurityError struct {
	Findings []publicationSecurityFinding `json:"findings"`
}

func (err *PublicationSecurityError) Error() string {
	return "publication snapshot contains possible secrets"
}

type preparedPublicationSnapshot struct {
	Archive        []byte
	SHA256         string
	Manifest       domain.PracticeTaskPublicationManifest
	SecurityReport domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSecurityReport
	Files          []domain.WorkspaceFile
}

func preparePublicationSnapshot(source []byte) (*preparedPublicationSnapshot, error) {
	if len(source) == 0 || len(source) > publicationMaxArchiveBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: submission archive must be between 1 byte and %d bytes", domain.ErrValidation, publicationMaxArchiveBytes)
	}
	reader, err := zip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(source), int64(len(source)))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: submission artifact is not a valid zip archive", domain.ErrValidation)
	}

	files := make([]domain.WorkspaceFile, 0, len(reader.File))
	excluded := make([]string, 0)
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(reader.File))
	findings := make([]publicationSecurityFinding, 0)
	totalBytes := 0
	for _, archived := range reader.File {
		filePath, include := publicCodePath(archived.Name)
		if !include || archived.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			if filePath != "" && !archived.FileInfo().IsDir() {
				excluded = append(excluded, filePath)
			}
			continue
		}
		if archived.Mode()&0o170000 != 0 && !archived.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication archive contains a non-regular entry", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[filePath]; duplicate {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication archive contains duplicate path %s", domain.ErrValidation, filePath)
		}
		seen[filePath] = struct{}{}
		if len(files) >= publicationMaxFiles || archived.UncompressedSize64 > publicationMaxFileBytes {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication code exceeds file count or per-file size limit", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		content, err := readPublicationZipFile(archived)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if !utf8.Valid(content) || bytes.IndexByte(content, 0) >= 0 {
			excluded = append(excluded, filePath)
			continue
		}
		totalBytes += len(content)
		if totalBytes > publicationMaxTotalBytes {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication code exceeds total size limit", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		findings = append(findings, scanPublicationSecrets(filePath, string(content))...)
		files = append(files, domain.WorkspaceFile{Path: filePath, Content: string(content)})
	}
	if len(findings) > 0 {
		sort.Slice(findings, func(left, right int) bool {
			if findings[left].Path != findings[right].Path {
				return findings[left].Path < findings[right].Path
			}
			if findings[left].Line != findings[right].Line {
				return findings[left].Line < findings[right].Line
			}
			return findings[left].Code < findings[right].Code
		})
		return nil, &PublicationSecurityError{Findings: findings}
	}
	if len(files) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication snapshot has no safe text source files", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	sort.Slice(files, func(left, right int) bool { return files[left].Path < files[right].Path })
	sort.Strings(excluded)
	excluded = uniqueStrings(excluded)

	archive, err := buildDeterministicPublicationArchive(files)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(archive)
	manifestFiles := make([]domain.PracticeTaskPublicationFile, 0, len(files))
	for _, file := range files {
		fileDigest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(file.Content))
		manifestFiles = append(manifestFiles, domain.PracticeTaskPublicationFile{
			Path: file.Path, Size: len(file.Content), SHA256: hex.EncodeToString(fileDigest[:]),
		})
	}
	return &preparedPublicationSnapshot{
		Archive: archive,
		SHA256:  hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]),
		Manifest: domain.PracticeTaskPublicationManifest{
			Version: 1, Files: manifestFiles, TotalBytes: totalBytes, ExcludedFilesCount: len(excluded),
		},
		SecurityReport: domain.PracticeTaskPublicationSecurityReport{Version: 1, ExcludedPaths: excluded},
		Files:          files,
	}, nil
}

func publicCodePath(value string) (string, bool) {
	value = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(value, "\\", "/"))
	clean := path.Clean(value)
	if value == "" || clean == "." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "/") || clean == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(clean, "../") {
		return "", false
	}
	segments := strings.Split(clean, "/")
	for _, segment := range segments {
		lower := strings.ToLower(segment)
		if _, blocked := publicationExcludedSegments[lower]; blocked {
			return clean, false
		}
	}
	base := strings.ToLower(segments[len(segments)-1])
	if _, sensitive := publicationSensitiveNames[base]; sensitive || strings.HasPrefix(base, ".env.") {
		return clean, false
	}
	for _, suffix := range publicationSensitiveSuffixes {
		if strings.HasSuffix(base, suffix) {
			return clean, false
		}
	}
	if _, allowed := publicationAllowedExtensionless[base]; allowed {
		return clean, true
	}
	extension := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(base))
	if base == ".gitignore" || base == ".dockerignore" {
		return clean, true
	}
	_, allowed := publicationTextExtensions[extension]
	return clean, allowed
}

func readPublicationZipFile(file *zip.File) ([]byte, error) {
	reader, err := file.Open()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: cannot open publication file", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	defer func() { _ = reader.Close() }()
	content, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(reader, publicationMaxFileBytes+1))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: cannot read publication file", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(content) > publicationMaxFileBytes {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: publication file exceeds size limit", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return content, nil
}

func scanPublicationSecrets(filePath, content string) []publicationSecurityFinding {
	findings := make([]publicationSecurityFinding, 0)
	for lineIndex, line := range strings.Split(content, "\n") {
		for _, candidate := range publicationSecretPatterns {
			matches := candidate.pattern.FindAllStringSubmatch(line, -1)
			for _, match := range matches {
				if candidate.value > 0 && candidate.value < len(match) && safePublicationCredentialValue(match[candidate.value]) {
					continue
				}
				findings = append(findings, publicationSecurityFinding{Path: filePath, Code: candidate.code, Line: lineIndex + 1})
			}
		}
	}
	return findings
}

func safePublicationCredentialValue(value string) bool {
	normalized := strings.ToLower(strings.Trim(value, `"'`))
	for _, marker := range []string{
		"change-me", "changeme", "dummy", "example", "fake", "placeholder", "redacted", "test", "your_", "your-",
		"getenv", "process.env", "os.environ", "env(", "${", "{{",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(normalized, marker) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func buildDeterministicPublicationArchive(files []domain.WorkspaceFile) ([]byte, error) {
	buffer := bytes.NewBuffer(nil)
	writer := zip.NewWriter(buffer)
	fixedTime := time.Unix(0, 0).UTC()
	for _, file := range files {
		header := &zip.FileHeader{Name: file.Path, Method: zip.Deflate}
		header.SetMode(0o644)
		header.Modified = fixedTime
		entry, err := writer.CreateHeader(header)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("build publication archive: %w", err)
		}
		if _, err := entry.Write([]byte(file.Content)); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("build publication archive: %w", err)
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("build publication archive: %w", err)
	}
	return buffer.Bytes(), nil
}

func uniqueStrings(values []string) []string {
	result := values[:0]
	for _, value := range values {
		if len(result) == 0 || result[len(result)-1] != value {
			result = append(result, value)
		}
	}
	return result
}
